step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Analyze visual elements on the whiteboard:
   - Top-left green cloud icon labeled 'AWS' (VPC).
   - Mid-left computer icon labeled 'ON-PREM' (OnPremDC).
   - Top-center orange compute icon labeled 'APACHE METRON' (ThirdParty).
   - Yellow dashed box titled 'SECURITY DATA LAKE' containing:
     - Blue EMR icon labeled 'EMR' (EMR).
     - Green S3 icon labeled 'S3' (S3).
     - Blue Athena icon labeled 'ATHENA' (Athena).
   - Top-right orange compute icon labeled 'SOAR' (ThirdParty).
   - Mid-right people icon labeled 'ALERTS' (UserCompanyDeveloper).
   - Bottom-right orange icon labeled 'WAF' (WAF).

2. Trace connections (arrows):
   - AWS -> Apache Metron (log ingestion)
   - On-Prem -> Apache Metron (log ingestion)
   - Apache Metron -> EMR (data persisting)
   - EMR -> S3 (storing processed data)
   - S3 -> Athena (querying/analytics)
   - S3 -> Apache Metron (feedback loop for long-term profiling)
   - Apache Metron -> SOAR (alert triggers)
   - SOAR -> Alerts/SOC Analysts (presentation to analysts)
   - Alerts -> WAF (mitigation/blocking rules)
